dedupe_keys.name: nlr cambium modelled hourly us electricity sector cost emission and operation metrics for future scenarios to 2050

description: Cambium is an annually updated National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL) set of modelled hourly data for a range of possible futures of the US electricity sector through 2050, with metrics designed for forward-looking analysis and decision support. Contents: the 2024 release, the fifth edition, has three products: the full hourly data sets in NLR's Scenario Viewer, a workbook with a subset of cost data to help users levelize values over their own time frame, and a technical report describing scenarios, metric definitions, methods, intended uses and limitations. Cambium expands the metrics of NLR's Standard Scenarios, which cover more scenarios at annual resolution only; both project the sector with NLR's ReEDS capacity expansion model. Producer: NLR Energy Systems Analysis (contact Pieter Gagnon). Coverage: United States electricity sector, hourly, to 2050. Format and access: view and download through the Cambium projects in the Scenario Viewer, with a data catalogue entry and technical reports (Cambium 2024 Scenario Descriptions and Documentation, 2025). Licence: not stated on the NLR page. Caveats: values are model projections under stated scenario assumptions, not forecasts, and the report lists limitations on use; editions change between years. Simulation uses: hourly marginal cost and emission signals for evaluating storage, flexible demand, electrification and EV charging strategies, and future grid conditions for infrastructure planning. Related records: data-nlr-standard-scenarios and model-reeds.
